title: Compact Cost Trace: Role-aware token cost inspector with exportable summary presets
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: Finance, platform, and product teams need compact, exportable views that explain token-level spend without dumping raw logs. Current console charts show aggregate spend but lack a concise row-level narrative and role-specific exports.

Solution summary: Design a "Compact Cost Trace" inspector panel that sits on top of existing route and model dashboards. The inspector provides: a condensed ledger row for selected time window, automatic attribution rollups (prompt vs system vs assistant tokens), adjustable apportionment presets (Owner, Finance, Platform), and one-click export templates (CSV, JSON, billing-ready CSV). The UI uses progressive disclosure so most users see a single-line summary with sparkline and cost delta; power users can expand to view token buckets, example prompt snippets, responsible model variant, and a compressed timeline of kernel/latency hotspots.

Goals: reduce time-to-answer for cost investigations, enable repeatable exports for chargebacks, and introduce pricing UI patterns (presets, column packs, and export templates) that map directly to billing pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Panel launches from route, model, or trace rows and shows a single-line condensed ledger with total cost, token counts, and a 7-day sparkline.
Users can switch attribution preset: Owner (assign to user), Finance (allocate by message share), Platform (allocate fixed infra overhead). Presets persist per-org.
Expand mode reveals token buckets (prompt/system/assistant), top 3 prompt snippets (anonymized), and a compressed event timeline for batching/caching hits.
Export menu provides three templates: simplified billing CSV, detailed JSON (for analysis), and sample-labeled CSV for finance ingestion. Exports match approved column pack definitions.
Accessibility: keyboard navigation for open/close, and screen-reader labels for key fields.
prototyping_notes: Use sampled traces aggregated to 1-minute buckets to avoid heavy queries in prototype.
Anonymize prompt snippets by default and include a reveal action only for org admins.
Sparkline uses 7-day rolling median to reduce noise from large bursts.
Column packs: 'Billing minimal', 'Billing detailed', 'Finance reconciliation' — define mapping in Confluence doc.
review_comments: PM (Aisha): Prefer 'Owner' preset to surface user assignment by default in accounts with <20 active users.
Eng (Marco): Backend needs a lightweight aggregation endpoint; avoid JOINs over full request logs for UI latency targets.
Design (Rina): Suggest microcopy explaining presets and impact on export columns; move presets into a compact popover.
Security (Daniel): Ensure exports redact PII; add audit log event for export actions.
dev_tasks: ENG-22311: aggregation endpoint for compact ledger rows
ENG-22345: export template generation and S3 staging
ENG-22400: RBAC check and audit log hook for exports
decisions: Start with three presets and allow admin to define custom presets in a follow-up ticket.
Default view is condensed single-row with optional expansion; full trace stays behind 'expand' to limit cognitive load.
Anonymize snippet text in exports unless exportor has finance role and explicit consent toggled.
next_steps: Finalize column pack mappings with Finance (due 2025-02-11).
Engineering spike to validate aggregation endpoint performance and cost (ENG-22311) — 2d spike.
Design to produce high-fidelity accessible variant and copy variants for presets popover.
Run 2-week pilot with 3 internal teams and capture feedback; create follow-ups for 'custom presets' and 'scheduled exports'.
